source_units.text: Cursed is the person who places his hope in a human and will rest the flesh of his arm upon him, and whose heart departs from the Lord;
source_units.complete_text: Cursed is the person who places his hope in a human and will rest the flesh of his arm upon him, and whose heart departs from the Lord;

source_units.text: and he will be like a wild tamarisk in the wilderness; he will not see when good things come, and will dwell among salt-plants and in a wilderness, in a salt land that is not inhabited.
source_units.complete_text: and he will be like a wild tamarisk in the wilderness; he will not see when good things come, and will dwell among salt-plants and in a wilderness, in a salt land that is not inhabited.

source_units.text: And blessed is the person who has trusted in the Lord, and the Lord will be his hope;
source_units.complete_text: And blessed is the person who has trusted in the Lord, and the Lord will be his hope;

source_units.text: and he will be like a tree flourishing beside waters, and will send its roots toward moisture, and will not fear when heat comes. Wooded stems will be upon it; in a rainless year it will not fear or cease bearing fruit.
source_units.complete_text: and he will be like a tree flourishing beside waters, and will send its roots toward moisture, and will not fear when heat comes. Wooded stems will be upon it; in a rainless year it will not fear or cease bearing fruit.

source_units.text: The heart is deep beyond all things, and so is a human; and who will know him?
source_units.complete_text: The heart is deep beyond all things, and so is a human; and who will know him?

source_units.text: I, the Lord, examine hearts and test kidneys, to give each according to his ways and the fruits of his practices.
source_units.complete_text: I, the Lord, examine hearts and test kidneys, to give each according to his ways and the fruits of his practices.

source_units.text: A partridge called; it gathered what it did not bear. One makes his wealth without judgment; in the middle of his days they will abandon him, and at his last he will be foolish.
source_units.complete_text: A partridge called; it gathered what it did not bear. One makes his wealth without judgment; in the middle of his days they will abandon him, and at his last he will be foolish.

source_units.text: An exalted throne of glory is our sanctuary,
source_units.complete_text: An exalted throne of glory is our sanctuary,

source_units.text: Israel’s patient expectation, Lord, let all who abandoned Thee be ashamed; let those who departed be written upon the earth, because they abandoned the Lord, the fountain of life.
source_units.complete_text: Israel’s patient expectation, Lord, let all who abandoned Thee be ashamed; let those who departed be written upon the earth, because they abandoned the Lord, the fountain of life.

source_units.text: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, because Thou art my boast.
source_units.complete_text: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, because Thou art my boast.

source_units.text: Behold, they say to me: Where is the Lord’s word? Let it come!
source_units.complete_text: Behold, they say to me: Where is the Lord’s word? Let it come!

source_units.text: But I did not grow weary following after Thee, and did not desire a human’s day; Thou knowest. The things going out through my lips are before Thee.
source_units.complete_text: But I did not grow weary following after Thee, and did not desire a human’s day; Thou knowest. The things going out through my lips are before Thee.

source_units.text: Do not become an estrangement to me, sparing me in an evil day.
source_units.complete_text: Do not become an estrangement to me, sparing me in an evil day.

source_units.text: Let those pursuing me be ashamed, and may I not be ashamed; may they be terrified, and may I not be terrified. Bring an evil day upon them; crush them with double crushing.
source_units.complete_text: Let those pursuing me be ashamed, and may I not be ashamed; may they be terrified, and may I not be terrified. Bring an evil day upon them; crush them with double crushing.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Go and stand in the gates of your people’s sons, through which Judah’s kings enter and leave, and in all Jerusalem’s gates,
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord: Go and stand in the gates of your people’s sons, through which Judah’s kings enter and leave, and in all Jerusalem’s gates,

source_units.text: and you will say to them: Hear the Lord’s word, kings of Judah, all Judea and all Jerusalem, who enter these gates:
source_units.complete_text: and you will say to them: Hear the Lord’s word, kings of Judah, all Judea and all Jerusalem, who enter these gates:

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Guard your souls, and do not lift burdens on the Sabbath day or go out through Jerusalem’s gates,
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord: Guard your souls, and do not lift burdens on the Sabbath day or go out through Jerusalem’s gates,

source_units.text: and do not bring burdens out of your houses on the Sabbath day, and you must do no work; consecrate the Sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers. And they did not hear or incline their ear,
source_units.complete_text: and do not bring burdens out of your houses on the Sabbath day, and you must do no work; consecrate the Sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers. And they did not hear or incline their ear,

source_units.text: and they hardened their neck beyond their fathers, so as not to hear Me or accept instruction.
source_units.complete_text: and they hardened their neck beyond their fathers, so as not to hear Me or accept instruction.

source_units.text: And if you truly listen to Me, says the Lord, not bringing burdens through this city’s gates on the Sabbath day and consecrating the Sabbath day by doing no work,
source_units.complete_text: And if you truly listen to Me, says the Lord, not bringing burdens through this city’s gates on the Sabbath day and consecrating the Sabbath day by doing no work,

source_units.text: then kings and rulers sitting on David’s throne will enter through this city’s gates, mounted on their chariots and horses, they and their rulers, Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem; and this city will be inhabited for ever.
source_units.complete_text: then kings and rulers sitting on David’s throne will enter through this city’s gates, mounted on their chariots and horses, they and their rulers, Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem; and this city will be inhabited for ever.

source_units.text: And they will come from Judah’s cities, around Jerusalem, Benjamin’s land, the plain, the mountain and the south, bringing whole burnt offerings, sacrifice, incense offerings, grain offering and frankincense, bringing praise into the Lord’s house.
source_units.complete_text: And they will come from Judah’s cities, around Jerusalem, Benjamin’s land, the plain, the mountain and the south, bringing whole burnt offerings, sacrifice, incense offerings, grain offering and frankincense, bringing praise into the Lord’s house.

source_units.text: And if you do not listen to Me to consecrate the Sabbath day, not lifting burdens and not entering Jerusalem’s gates on the Sabbath day, I will kindle fire in her gates, and it will devour Jerusalem’s quarters and not be extinguished.
source_units.complete_text: And if you do not listen to Me to consecrate the Sabbath day, not lifting burdens and not entering Jerusalem’s gates on the Sabbath day, I will kindle fire in her gates, and it will devour Jerusalem’s quarters and not be extinguished.

source_units.text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:
source_units.complete_text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:

source_units.text: Rise and go down to the potter’s house, and there you will hear My words.
source_units.complete_text: Rise and go down to the potter’s house, and there you will hear My words.

source_units.text: And I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was doing work upon the stones.
source_units.complete_text: And I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was doing work upon the stones.

source_units.text: And the vessel he was making fell apart in his hands, and again he made it another vessel, as pleased him to make.
source_units.complete_text: And the vessel he was making fell apart in his hands, and again he made it another vessel, as pleased him to make.

source_units.text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:
source_units.complete_text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:

source_units.text: Can I not shape you as this potter does, house of Israel? Behold, you are like the potter’s clay in My hands.
source_units.complete_text: Can I not shape you as this potter does, house of Israel? Behold, you are like the potter’s clay in My hands.

source_units.text: At last I will speak concerning a nation or kingdom, to remove them and destroy,
source_units.complete_text: At last I will speak concerning a nation or kingdom, to remove them and destroy,

source_units.text: and if that nation turns from all their evils, I will change My mind concerning the evils I planned to do to them.
source_units.complete_text: and if that nation turns from all their evils, I will change My mind concerning the evils I planned to do to them.

source_units.text: And at last I will speak concerning a nation and kingdom, for it to be rebuilt and planted,
source_units.complete_text: And at last I will speak concerning a nation and kingdom, for it to be rebuilt and planted,

source_units.text: and if they do evil things before Me by not hearing My voice, I will change My mind concerning the good things I spoke of doing for them.
source_units.complete_text: and if they do evil things before Me by not hearing My voice, I will change My mind concerning the good things I spoke of doing for them.

source_units.text: And now say to Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem: Behold, I am shaping evils against you and devising a design against you. Let each turn from his evil way now, and make your practices better.
source_units.complete_text: And now say to Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem: Behold, I am shaping evils against you and devising a design against you. Let each turn from his evil way now, and make your practices better.

source_units.text: And they said: We will be resolute, because we will follow our turnings away, and each will do what pleases his evil heart.
source_units.complete_text: And they said: We will be resolute, because we will follow our turnings away, and each will do what pleases his evil heart.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Ask now among the nations: Who heard such horrifying things that virgin Israel committed so greatly?
source_units.complete_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Ask now among the nations: Who heard such horrifying things that virgin Israel committed so greatly?

source_units.text: Will breasts fail from a rock, or snow from Lebanon? Will water borne violently by wind turn aside?
source_units.complete_text: Will breasts fail from a rock, or snow from Lebanon? Will water borne violently by wind turn aside?

source_units.text: Because My people forgot Me, they burned incense in vain; and they will become weak in their ways, the age-old tracks, to step upon paths having no road for travel,
source_units.complete_text: Because My people forgot Me, they burned incense in vain; and they will become weak in their ways, the age-old tracks, to step upon paths having no road for travel,

source_units.text: to make their land a ruin and an eternal hissing; all who pass through it will be astonished and shake their head.
source_units.complete_text: to make their land a ruin and an eternal hissing; all who pass through it will be astonished and shake their head.

source_units.text: Like a scorching wind I will scatter them before their enemies; I will show them their day of destruction.
source_units.complete_text: Like a scorching wind I will scatter them before their enemies; I will show them their day of destruction.

source_units.text: And they said: Come, let us devise a design against Jeremiah, because law will not perish from a priest, counsel from the discerning, or word from a prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and we will hear all his words.
source_units.complete_text: And they said: Come, let us devise a design against Jeremiah, because law will not perish from a priest, counsel from the discerning, or word from a prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and we will hear all his words.

source_units.text: Listen to me, Lord, and listen to the voice of my claim of right.
source_units.complete_text: Listen to me, Lord, and listen to the voice of my claim of right.

source_units.text: Is evil repaid for good things? For they spoke words together against my soul and hid their punishment for me. Remember my standing before Thee to speak good things for them, to turn Thy fury from them.
source_units.complete_text: Is evil repaid for good things? For they spoke words together against my soul and hid their punishment for me. Remember my standing before Thee to speak good things for them, to turn Thy fury from them.

source_units.text: Therefore give their sons to famine and gather them into the sword’s hands. Let their women become childless and widowed, their men killed by death, and their young men fallen by the sword in war.
source_units.complete_text: Therefore give their sons to famine and gather them into the sword’s hands. Let their women become childless and widowed, their men killed by death, and their young men fallen by the sword in war.

source_units.text: Let there be a cry in their houses; Thou wilt bring robbers upon them suddenly, because they attempted a plan for my capture and hid traps against me.
source_units.complete_text: Let there be a cry in their houses; Thou wilt bring robbers upon them suddenly, because they attempted a plan for my capture and hid traps against me.

source_units.text: And Thou, Lord, knewest all their counsel against me for death. Do not acquit their injustices or erase their sins from before Thee. Let their weakness be before Thee; act among them in the time of Thy fury.
source_units.complete_text: And Thou, Lord, knewest all their counsel against me for death. Do not acquit their injustices or erase their sins from before Thee. Let their weakness be before Thee; act among them in the time of Thy fury.

source_units.text: Then the Lord said to me: Go and acquire a molded earthenware jar, and bring some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests.
source_units.complete_text: Then the Lord said to me: Go and acquire a molded earthenware jar, and bring some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests.

source_units.text: And go out to the burial ground of the sons of their children, which is before the Charsith Gate, and read there all the words that I speak to you.
source_units.complete_text: And go out to the burial ground of the sons of their children, which is before the Charsith Gate, and read there all the words that I speak to you.

source_units.text: And say to them: Hear the Lord’s word, kings of Judah, men of Judah, inhabitants of Jerusalem, and those entering these gates. Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this place, so that both ears of everyone hearing them will ring.
source_units.complete_text: And say to them: Hear the Lord’s word, kings of Judah, men of Judah, inhabitants of Jerusalem, and those entering these gates. Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this place, so that both ears of everyone hearing them will ring.

source_units.text: Because they abandoned Me and alienated this place, burning incense in it to foreign gods whom neither they nor their fathers knew; and Judah’s kings filled this place with innocent blood,
source_units.complete_text: Because they abandoned Me and alienated this place, burning incense in it to foreign gods whom neither they nor their fathers knew; and Judah’s kings filled this place with innocent blood,

source_units.text: and built high places for Baal to burn their sons in fire, things I did not command or speak of or conceive in My heart.
source_units.complete_text: and built high places for Baal to burn their sons in fire, things I did not command or speak of or conceive in My heart.

source_units.text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place will no longer be called Collapse or the Burial Ground of the Son of Hinnom, but the Burial Ground of Slaughter.
source_units.complete_text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place will no longer be called Collapse or the Burial Ground of the Son of Hinnom, but the Burial Ground of Slaughter.

source_units.text: And I will slaughter Judah’s counsel and Jerusalem’s counsel in this place, and cast them down by the sword before their enemies and into the hands of those seeking their lives. I will give their dead as food to the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth.
source_units.complete_text: And I will slaughter Judah’s counsel and Jerusalem’s counsel in this place, and cast them down by the sword before their enemies and into the hands of those seeking their lives. I will give their dead as food to the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth.

source_units.text: And I will make this city a ruin and a hissing. Everyone passing through it will look gloomy and hiss over its whole wound.
source_units.complete_text: And I will make this city a ruin and a hissing. Everyone passing through it will look gloomy and hiss over its whole wound.

source_units.text: And they will eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and each will eat his neighbor’s flesh in the encirclement and siege with which their enemies will besiege them.
source_units.complete_text: And they will eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and each will eat his neighbor’s flesh in the encirclement and siege with which their enemies will besiege them.

source_units.text: And smash the jar before the eyes of the men going out with you,
source_units.complete_text: And smash the jar before the eyes of the men going out with you,

source_units.text: and say: Thus says the Lord: This is how I will smash this people and this city, as an earthenware vessel is smashed that cannot be healed again.
source_units.complete_text: and say: Thus says the Lord: This is how I will smash this people and this city, as an earthenware vessel is smashed that cannot be healed again.

source_units.text: This is what I will do, says the Lord, to this place and its inhabitants, so that this city is made like the collapsing place.
source_units.complete_text: This is what I will do, says the Lord, to this place and its inhabitants, so that this city is made like the collapsing place.

source_units.text: And Jerusalem’s houses and the houses of Judah’s kings will be like the collapsing place of uncleannesses, in all the houses where they burned incense upon their roofs to all the host of the heavens and poured drink offerings to foreign gods.
source_units.complete_text: And Jerusalem’s houses and the houses of Judah’s kings will be like the collapsing place of uncleannesses, in all the houses where they burned incense upon their roofs to all the host of the heavens and poured drink offerings to foreign gods.

source_units.text: And Jeremiah came from Collapse, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, stood in the courtyard of the Lord’s house, and said to all the people:
source_units.complete_text: And Jeremiah came from Collapse, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, stood in the courtyard of the Lord’s house, and said to all the people:

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing upon this city, all its towns, and its villages all the evils I spoke against it, because they hardened their necks so as not to listen to My words.
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing upon this city, all its towns, and its villages all the evils I spoke against it, because they hardened their necks so as not to listen to My words.

source_units.text: And Pashhur son of Immer, the priest who had been appointed leader of the Lord’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
source_units.complete_text: And Pashhur son of Immer, the priest who had been appointed leader of the Lord’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.

source_units.text: And he struck him and put him into the trap, which was at the gate of the separated upper house that was in the Lord’s house.
source_units.complete_text: And he struck him and put him into the trap, which was at the gate of the separated upper house that was in the Lord’s house.

source_units.text: And Pashhur brought Jeremiah out of the trap, and Jeremiah said to him: The Lord has called your name not Pashhur but Migrant.
source_units.complete_text: And Pashhur brought Jeremiah out of the trap, and Jeremiah said to him: The Lord has called your name not Pashhur but Migrant.

source_units.text: Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I am giving you to migration with all your friends. They will fall by their enemies’ sword, and your eyes will see. I will give you and all Judah into the hands of Babylon’s king, and they will deport them and cut them down with swords.
source_units.complete_text: Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I am giving you to migration with all your friends. They will fall by their enemies’ sword, and your eyes will see. I will give you and all Judah into the hands of Babylon’s king, and they will deport them and cut them down with swords.

source_units.text: And I will give all this city’s strength, all its labors, and all the treasures of Judah’s king into his enemies’ hands, and they will bring them to Babylon.
source_units.complete_text: And I will give all this city’s strength, all its labors, and all the treasures of Judah’s king into his enemies’ hands, and they will bring them to Babylon.

source_units.text: And you and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. In Babylon you will die and there be buried—you and all your friends to whom you prophesied false things.
source_units.complete_text: And you and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. In Babylon you will die and there be buried—you and all your friends to whom you prophesied false things.

source_units.text: Thou didst deceive me, Lord, and I was deceived. Thou tookest hold and didst prevail. I became a laughingstock; all day I continued being mocked.
source_units.complete_text: Thou didst deceive me, Lord, and I was deceived. Thou tookest hold and didst prevail. I became a laughingstock; all day I continued being mocked.

source_units.text: Because I will laugh with my bitter word; I will call upon rejection and misery, because the Lord’s word became a reproach and a derision to me all day long.
source_units.complete_text: Because I will laugh with my bitter word; I will call upon rejection and misery, because the Lord’s word became a reproach and a derision to me all day long.

source_units.text: And I said: I will certainly not name the Lord’s name or speak in His name again. And it became like a burning fire blazing in my bones; I am weakened on every side and cannot bear it.
source_units.complete_text: And I said: I will certainly not name the Lord’s name or speak in His name again. And it became like a burning fire blazing in my bones; I am weakened on every side and cannot bear it.

source_units.text: Because I heard the reproach of many gathering all around: Rise against him, and let us rise against him, all you men who are his friends! Watch his purpose, to see whether he will be deceived and we can prevail against him and take our revenge on him.
source_units.complete_text: Because I heard the reproach of many gathering all around: Rise against him, and let us rise against him, all you men who are his friends! Watch his purpose, to see whether he will be deceived and we can prevail against him and take our revenge on him.

source_units.text: And the Lord is with me like a strong fighter. Therefore they pursued and could not understand; they were greatly shamed, because they did not understand their dishonors, which will never be forgotten.
source_units.complete_text: And the Lord is with me like a strong fighter. Therefore they pursued and could not understand; they were greatly shamed, because they did not understand their dishonors, which will never be forgotten.

source_units.text: Lord, testing righteous things, understanding kidneys and hearts: May I see the vengeance from Thee among them, because to Thee I disclosed my defenses.
source_units.complete_text: Lord, testing righteous things, understanding kidneys and hearts: May I see the vengeance from Thee among them, because to Thee I disclosed my defenses.

source_units.text: Sing to the Lord; praise Him, because He rescued a poor person’s life from the hand of those doing evil.
source_units.complete_text: Sing to the Lord; praise Him, because He rescued a poor person’s life from the hand of those doing evil.

source_units.text: Accursed be the day on which I was born! Let the day my mother bore me not be a day to pray for!
source_units.complete_text: Accursed be the day on which I was born! Let the day my mother bore me not be a day to pray for!

source_units.text: Accursed be the man who brought my father good news, saying, A boy has been born to you!—rejoicing.
source_units.complete_text: Accursed be the man who brought my father good news, saying, A boy has been born to you!—rejoicing.

source_units.text: Let that man be like the cities the Lord overthrew in fury without changing His mind. Let him hear a cry in the morning and a battle shout at noon,
source_units.complete_text: Let that man be like the cities the Lord overthrew in fury without changing His mind. Let him hear a cry in the morning and a battle shout at noon,

source_units.text: because he did not kill me in my mother’s womb, so that my mother would have become my tomb and the womb one of everlasting conception.
source_units.complete_text: because he did not kill me in my mother’s womb, so that my mother would have become my tomb and the womb one of everlasting conception.

source_units.text: Why did I come out from the womb to see labors and pains, and have my days continue in shame?
source_units.complete_text: Why did I come out from the womb to see labors and pains, and have my days continue in shame?

source_units.text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, saying:
source_units.complete_text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, saying:

source_units.text: Ask the Lord about us, because Babylon’s king has come against us, whether the Lord will act according to all His wonders, so that he goes away from us.
source_units.complete_text: Ask the Lord about us, because Babylon’s king has come against us, whether the Lord will act according to all His wonders, so that he goes away from us.

source_units.text: And Jeremiah said to them: Say this to Zedekiah king of Judah:
source_units.complete_text: And Jeremiah said to them: Say this to Zedekiah king of Judah:

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am turning the weapons of war with which you fight the Chaldeans who have shut you in outside the wall into this city,
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am turning the weapons of war with which you fight the Chaldeans who have shut you in outside the wall into this city,

source_units.text: and I Myself will fight you with outstretched hand and mighty arm, with fury, anger, and great indignation.
source_units.complete_text: and I Myself will fight you with outstretched hand and mighty arm, with fury, anger, and great indignation.

source_units.text: And I will strike all this city’s inhabitants, the people and the livestock, with a great death, and they will die.
source_units.complete_text: And I will strike all this city’s inhabitants, the people and the livestock, with a great death, and they will die.

source_units.text: And afterward—thus says the Lord—I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people remaining in this city after death, famine, and sword into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives. They will cut them down with the sword’s edge. I will not spare them or have compassion on them.
source_units.complete_text: And afterward—thus says the Lord—I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people remaining in this city after death, famine, and sword into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives. They will cut them down with the sword’s edge. I will not spare them or have compassion on them.

source_units.text: And say to this people: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have set before your face the way of life and the way of death.
source_units.complete_text: And say to this people: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have set before your face the way of life and the way of death.

source_units.text: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine; whoever goes out to join the Chaldeans who have shut you in will live, and his life will be spoil, and he will live.
source_units.complete_text: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine; whoever goes out to join the Chaldeans who have shut you in will live, and his life will be spoil, and he will live.

source_units.text: Because I have fixed My face upon this city for evils and not for good things. It will be handed into Babylon’s king’s hands, and he will burn it down with fire.
source_units.complete_text: Because I have fixed My face upon this city for evils and not for good things. It will be handed into Babylon’s king’s hands, and he will burn it down with fire.

source_units.text: House of Judah’s king, hear the Lord’s word.
source_units.complete_text: House of Judah’s king, hear the Lord’s word.

source_units.text: House of David, thus says the Lord: Judge a judgment in the morning, set things straight, and rescue the plundered from the hand of the one wronging him, so that My anger is not kindled like fire and burns with no one to quench it.
source_units.complete_text: House of David, thus says the Lord: Judge a judgment in the morning, set things straight, and rescue the plundered from the hand of the one wronging him, so that My anger is not kindled like fire and burns with no one to quench it.

source_units.text: Behold, I am against you who dwell in the valley of Sor, the level land, you who say, Who will frighten us? Or who will enter our dwelling?
source_units.complete_text: Behold, I am against you who dwell in the valley of Sor, the level land, you who say, Who will frighten us? Or who will enter our dwelling?

source_units.text: And I will kindle a fire in her woodland, and it will consume everything around her.
source_units.complete_text: And I will kindle a fire in her woodland, and it will consume everything around her.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Go and descend to the house of Judah’s king and speak this word there,
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord: Go and descend to the house of Judah’s king and speak this word there,

source_units.text: and say: Hear the Lord’s word, king of Judah who sits on David’s throne—you, your household, your people, and those entering these gates.
source_units.complete_text: and say: Hear the Lord’s word, king of Judah who sits on David’s throne—you, your household, your people, and those entering these gates.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Do justice and righteousness; rescue the plundered from the hand of the one wronging him. Do not oppress the newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not act impiously or shed innocent blood in this place.
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord: Do justice and righteousness; rescue the plundered from the hand of the one wronging him. Do not oppress the newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not act impiously or shed innocent blood in this place.

source_units.text: Because if you truly carry out this word, kings sitting upon David’s throne and riding chariots and horses will enter this house’s gates—they, their servants, and their people.
source_units.complete_text: Because if you truly carry out this word, kings sitting upon David’s throne and riding chariots and horses will enter this house’s gates—they, their servants, and their people.

source_units.text: But if you do not carry out these words, I swear by Myself, says the Lord, that this house will become a desolation.
source_units.complete_text: But if you do not carry out these words, I swear by Myself, says the Lord, that this house will become a desolation.

source_units.text: Because thus says the Lord against the house of Judah’s king: You are Gilead to Me, the head of Lebanon; surely I will make you a wilderness, cities that will not be inhabited.
source_units.complete_text: Because thus says the Lord against the house of Judah’s king: You are Gilead to Me, the head of Lebanon; surely I will make you a wilderness, cities that will not be inhabited.

source_units.text: And I will bring against you a destroying man and his axe, and they will cut down your chosen cedars and cast them into the fire.
source_units.complete_text: And I will bring against you a destroying man and his axe, and they will cut down your chosen cedars and cast them into the fire.

source_units.text: And nations will pass through this city, and each will say to his neighbor: Why did the Lord act this way toward this great city?
source_units.complete_text: And nations will pass through this city, and each will say to his neighbor: Why did the Lord act this way toward this great city?

source_units.text: And they will say: Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord their God, bowed down to foreign gods, and served them.
source_units.complete_text: And they will say: Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord their God, bowed down to foreign gods, and served them.

source_units.text: Do not weep for the dead or lament him; weep bitterly for the one going out, because he will never return or see his homeland.
source_units.complete_text: Do not weep for the dead or lament him; weep bitterly for the one going out, because he will never return or see his homeland.

source_units.text: Because thus says the Lord concerning Shallum son of Josiah, who reigned in place of his father Josiah and went out from this place: He will not return there again,
source_units.complete_text: Because thus says the Lord concerning Shallum son of Josiah, who reigned in place of his father Josiah and went out from this place: He will not return there again,

source_units.text: but in the place where I deported him, there he will die, and he will never see this land again.
source_units.complete_text: but in the place where I deported him, there he will die, and he will never see this land again.

source_units.text: O you who build your house without righteousness and your upper rooms without judgment! He works through his neighbor without payment and will not give him his wages.
source_units.complete_text: O you who build your house without righteousness and your upper rooms without judgment! He works through his neighbor without payment and will not give him his wages.

source_units.text: You built yourself a well-proportioned house, airy upper rooms set apart by windows, paneled with cedar and painted with red ocher.
source_units.complete_text: You built yourself a well-proportioned house, airy upper rooms set apart by windows, paneled with cedar and painted with red ocher.

source_units.text: Will you reign because you are provoked in Ahaz your father? They will not eat or drink. It was better for you to do judgment and good righteousness.
source_units.complete_text: Will you reign because you are provoked in Ahaz your father? They will not eat or drink. It was better for you to do judgment and good righteousness.

source_units.text: They did not know; they did not judge a case for the lowly or a case for the poor. Is this not your failing to know Me? says the Lord.
source_units.complete_text: They did not know; they did not judge a case for the lowly or a case for the poor. Is this not your failing to know Me? says the Lord.

source_units.text: Behold, neither your eyes nor your heart are good; instead they are directed toward your greed, innocent blood to shed it, wrongdoing, and murder to commit it.
source_units.complete_text: Behold, neither your eyes nor your heart are good; instead they are directed toward your greed, innocent blood to shed it, wrongdoing, and murder to commit it.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: Woe upon this man! They will certainly not mourn him, O brother! Nor will they weep for him, Alas, lord!
source_units.complete_text: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: Woe upon this man! They will certainly not mourn him, O brother! Nor will they weep for him, Alas, lord!

source_units.text: He will be buried with a donkey’s burial; swept up, he will be thrown beyond Jerusalem’s gate.
source_units.complete_text: He will be buried with a donkey’s burial; swept up, he will be thrown beyond Jerusalem’s gate.

source_units.text: Go up to Lebanon and cry out; raise your voice in Bashan and shout to the far side of the sea, because all your lovers have been shattered.
source_units.complete_text: Go up to Lebanon and cry out; raise your voice in Bashan and shout to the far side of the sea, because all your lovers have been shattered.

source_units.text: I spoke to you in your falling away, and you said, I will not listen. This is your way from your youth: you did not hear My voice.
source_units.complete_text: I spoke to you in your falling away, and you said, I will not listen. This is your way from your youth: you did not hear My voice.

source_units.text: Wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go out in captivity. Then you will be ashamed and dishonored because of all who love you.
source_units.complete_text: Wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go out in captivity. Then you will be ashamed and dishonored because of all who love you.

source_units.text: You who dwell in Lebanon and nest among the cedars will groan when pangs come upon you like those of a woman giving birth.
source_units.complete_text: You who dwell in Lebanon and nest among the cedars will groan when pangs come upon you like those of a woman giving birth.

source_units.text: As I live, says the Lord, even if Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, becomes a signet on My right hand, I will pull you off from there,
source_units.complete_text: As I live, says the Lord, even if Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, becomes a signet on My right hand, I will pull you off from there,

source_units.text: and hand you into the hands of those seeking your life, those before whom you are afraid, into the hands of the Chaldeans.
source_units.complete_text: and hand you into the hands of those seeking your life, those before whom you are afraid, into the hands of the Chaldeans.

source_units.text: And I will cast you and your mother who bore you into a land where you were not born, and there you both will die.
source_units.complete_text: And I will cast you and your mother who bore you into a land where you were not born, and there you both will die.

source_units.text: But to the land for which they pray in their souls, they will certainly not return.
source_units.complete_text: But to the land for which they pray in their souls, they will certainly not return.

source_units.text: Jeconiah was dishonored like a vessel for which there is no use, because he was cast out and thrown into a land he did not know.
source_units.complete_text: Jeconiah was dishonored like a vessel for which there is no use, because he was cast out and thrown into a land he did not know.

source_units.text: Land, land, hear the Lord’s word:
source_units.complete_text: Land, land, hear the Lord’s word:

source_units.text: Record this man as an outcast, because no man from his offspring will grow great sitting on David’s throne and ruling again in Judah.
source_units.complete_text: Record this man as an outcast, because no man from his offspring will grow great sitting on David’s throne and ruling again in Judah.

source_units.text: O shepherds who scatter and destroy the sheep of My pasture!
source_units.complete_text: O shepherds who scatter and destroy the sheep of My pasture!

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord to those shepherding My people: You scattered My sheep and drove them out without visiting them. Behold, I am exacting justice from you according to your evil practices.
source_units.complete_text: Therefore thus says the Lord to those shepherding My people: You scattered My sheep and drove them out without visiting them. Behold, I am exacting justice from you according to your evil practices.

source_units.text: And I will receive the remnant of My people from all the land where I drove them out, and establish them in their pasture; they will increase and multiply.
source_units.complete_text: And I will receive the remnant of My people from all the land where I drove them out, and establish them in their pasture; they will increase and multiply.

source_units.text: And I will raise shepherds for them who will tend them, and they will no longer fear or be frightened, says the Lord.
source_units.complete_text: And I will raise shepherds for them who will tend them, and they will no longer fear or be frightened, says the Lord.

source_units.text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will raise up a righteous rising for David. A king will reign and understand, doing judgment and righteousness upon the earth.
source_units.complete_text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will raise up a righteous rising for David. A king will reign and understand, doing judgment and righteousness upon the earth.

source_units.text: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell confidently. This is his name, which the Lord will call him: Josedek.
source_units.complete_text: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell confidently. This is his name, which the Lord will call him: Josedek.

source_units.text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say, As the Lord lives, who brought Israel’s house up from Egypt’s land,
source_units.complete_text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say, As the Lord lives, who brought Israel’s house up from Egypt’s land,

source_units.text: but, As the Lord lives, who gathered all Israel’s offspring from the northern land and all the countries where He drove them out, and restored them to their land.
source_units.complete_text: but, As the Lord lives, who gathered all Israel’s offspring from the northern land and all the countries where He drove them out, and restored them to their land.

source_units.text: Among the prophets my heart was shattered; within me all my bones were shaken. I became like a shattered man, like a person gripped by wine, before the Lord and the splendor of His glory.
source_units.complete_text: Among the prophets my heart was shattered; within me all my bones were shaken. I became like a shattered man, like a person gripped by wine, before the Lord and the splendor of His glory.

source_units.text: Because of these things the land mourned and the wilderness pastures dried up. Their course became evil, and their strength was not so.
source_units.complete_text: Because of these things the land mourned and the wilderness pastures dried up. Their course became evil, and their strength was not so.

source_units.text: Because priest and prophet were defiled, and in My house I saw their evils.
source_units.complete_text: Because priest and prophet were defiled, and in My house I saw their evils.

source_units.text: Therefore let their way become a slippery place for them in darkness, and they will be tripped and fall in it, because I will bring evils upon them in their year of visitation, says the Lord.
source_units.complete_text: Therefore let their way become a slippery place for them in darkness, and they will be tripped and fall in it, because I will bring evils upon them in their year of visitation, says the Lord.

source_units.text: And among Samaria’s prophets I saw lawless acts: they prophesied through Baal and led My people Israel astray.
source_units.complete_text: And among Samaria’s prophets I saw lawless acts: they prophesied through Baal and led My people Israel astray.

source_units.text: And among Jerusalem’s prophets I have seen horrifying things: committing adultery, walking in lies, and supporting evil hands so that no one turns from his evil way. They all became like Sodom to Me, and her inhabitants like Gomorrah.
source_units.complete_text: And among Jerusalem’s prophets I have seen horrifying things: committing adultery, walking in lies, and supporting evil hands so that no one turns from his evil way. They all became like Sodom to Me, and her inhabitants like Gomorrah.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will feed them pain and give them bitter water to drink, because from Jerusalem’s prophets defilement went out into all the land.
source_units.complete_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will feed them pain and give them bitter water to drink, because from Jerusalem’s prophets defilement went out into all the land.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Do not listen to the prophets’ words, because they make a vision futile for themselves. They speak from their own heart and not from the Lord’s mouth.
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Do not listen to the prophets’ words, because they make a vision futile for themselves. They speak from their own heart and not from the Lord’s mouth.

source_units.text: They say to those rejecting the Lord’s word, You will have peace. To all who walk according to their own wishes, to everyone walking in the wandering of his heart, they said, No evils will come upon you.
source_units.complete_text: They say to those rejecting the Lord’s word, You will have peace. To all who walk according to their own wishes, to everyone walking in the wandering of his heart, they said, No evils will come upon you.

source_units.text: Because who stood in the Lord’s standing place and saw His word? Who gave ear and heard?
source_units.complete_text: Because who stood in the Lord’s standing place and saw His word? Who gave ear and heard?

source_units.text: Behold, a shaking comes from the Lord, and anger goes out into a convulsion; swirling, it will come upon the ungodly.
source_units.complete_text: Behold, a shaking comes from the Lord, and anger goes out into a convulsion; swirling, it will come upon the ungodly.

source_units.text: And the Lord’s fury will no longer turn back until He does it and raises it up from His heart’s undertaking. At the end of the days they will understand these things.
source_units.complete_text: And the Lord’s fury will no longer turn back until He does it and raises it up from His heart’s undertaking. At the end of the days they will understand these things.

source_units.text: I was not sending the prophets, yet they ran; I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.
source_units.complete_text: I was not sending the prophets, yet they ran; I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.

source_units.text: And if they had stood in My standing presence and listened to My words, they would have turned My people from their evil practices.
source_units.complete_text: And if they had stood in My standing presence and listened to My words, they would have turned My people from their evil practices.

source_units.text: I am a God drawing near, says the Lord, and not a God far away.
source_units.complete_text: I am a God drawing near, says the Lord, and not a God far away.

source_units.text: If a person hides in hidden places, will I not see him? Do I not fill the heaven and the earth? says the Lord.
source_units.complete_text: If a person hides in hidden places, will I not see him? Do I not fill the heaven and the earth? says the Lord.

source_units.text: I heard what the prophets speak, the false things they prophesy in My name, saying, I dreamed a dream.
source_units.complete_text: I heard what the prophets speak, the false things they prophesy in My name, saying, I dreamed a dream.

source_units.text: How long will it be in the heart of the prophets prophesying false things, and in their prophesying the wishes of their own heart?
source_units.complete_text: How long will it be in the heart of the prophets prophesying false things, and in their prophesying the wishes of their own heart?

source_units.text: They plan to forget My law through their dreams, which each told his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot My name through Baal.
source_units.complete_text: They plan to forget My law through their dreams, which each told his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot My name through Baal.

source_units.text: Let the prophet in whom there is a dream tell his dream, and the one to whom My word comes tell My word in truth. What has chaff to do with wheat? So are My words, says the Lord.
source_units.complete_text: Let the prophet in whom there is a dream tell his dream, and the one to whom My word comes tell My word in truth. What has chaff to do with wheat? So are My words, says the Lord.

source_units.text: Are not My words like blazing fire, says the Lord, and like an axe cutting rock?
source_units.complete_text: Are not My words like blazing fire, says the Lord, and like an axe cutting rock?

source_units.text: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets, says the Lord God, who steal My words, each from his neighbor.
source_units.complete_text: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets, says the Lord God, who steal My words, each from his neighbor.

source_units.text: Behold, I am against the prophets who cast out prophecies of the tongue and doze their own dozing.
source_units.complete_text: Behold, I am against the prophets who cast out prophecies of the tongue and doze their own dozing.

source_units.text: Behold, I am against the prophets who prophesy false dreams, who told them and led My people astray by their lies and wanderings. I did not send or command them, and they will bring this people no benefit at all.
source_units.complete_text: Behold, I am against the prophets who prophesy false dreams, who told them and led My people astray by their lies and wanderings. I did not send or command them, and they will bring this people no benefit at all.

source_units.text: And if this people, a priest, or a prophet asks you, What is the Lord’s burden? say to them, You are the burden, and I will dash you down, says the Lord.
source_units.complete_text: And if this people, a priest, or a prophet asks you, What is the Lord’s burden? say to them, You are the burden, and I will dash you down, says the Lord.

source_units.text: And the prophet, priest, or people who say, The Lord’s burden—I will exact justice from that person and his household.
source_units.complete_text: And the prophet, priest, or people who say, The Lord’s burden—I will exact justice from that person and his household.

source_units.text: For this is what you will say, each to his neighbor and his brother: What did the Lord answer? What did the Lord speak?
source_units.complete_text: For this is what you will say, each to his neighbor and his brother: What did the Lord answer? What did the Lord speak?

source_units.text: And do not name the Lord’s burden again, because a person’s own word will be his burden.
source_units.complete_text: And do not name the Lord’s burden again, because a person’s own word will be his burden.

source_units.text: And why did the Lord our God speak?
source_units.complete_text: And why did the Lord our God speak?

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord God: Because you said this word, The Lord’s burden, though I sent to you saying, Do not say The Lord’s burden,
source_units.complete_text: Therefore thus says the Lord God: Because you said this word, The Lord’s burden, though I sent to you saying, Do not say The Lord’s burden,

source_units.text: therefore behold, I seize you and dash you down, along with the city I gave to you and your fathers,
source_units.complete_text: therefore behold, I seize you and dash you down, along with the city I gave to you and your fathers,

source_units.text: and I will put eternal reproach and eternal dishonor upon you, which will not be forgotten.
source_units.complete_text: and I will put eternal reproach and eternal dishonor upon you, which will not be forgotten.

source_units.text: The Lord showed me two baskets of figs lying before the Lord’s sanctuary, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had deported Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, the rulers, craftsmen, prisoners, and rich people from Jerusalem and brought them to Babylon.
source_units.complete_text: The Lord showed me two baskets of figs lying before the Lord’s sanctuary, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had deported Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, the rulers, craftsmen, prisoners, and rich people from Jerusalem and brought them to Babylon.

source_units.text: One basket had very good figs, like early figs; the other basket had very bad figs that could not be eaten because of their badness.
source_units.complete_text: One basket had very good figs, like early figs; the other basket had very bad figs that could not be eaten because of their badness.

source_units.text: And the Lord said to me: What do you see, Jeremiah? I said: Figs. The good are exceedingly good, and the bad exceedingly bad; they cannot be eaten because of their badness.
source_units.complete_text: And the Lord said to me: What do you see, Jeremiah? I said: Figs. The good are exceedingly good, and the bad exceedingly bad; they cannot be eaten because of their badness.

source_units.text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:
source_units.complete_text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Like these good figs, so I will acknowledge Judah’s deportees, whom I have sent from this place to the Chaldeans’ land, for good things.
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Like these good figs, so I will acknowledge Judah’s deportees, whom I have sent from this place to the Chaldeans’ land, for good things.

source_units.text: And I will fix My eyes upon them for good things and restore them to this land for good things. I will rebuild them and certainly not tear them down, plant them and certainly not pluck them out.
source_units.complete_text: And I will fix My eyes upon them for good things and restore them to this land for good things. I will rebuild them and certainly not tear them down, plant them and certainly not pluck them out.

source_units.text: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the Lord. They will be My people and I will be their God, because they will return to Me from their whole heart.
source_units.complete_text: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the Lord. They will be My people and I will be their God, because they will return to Me from their whole heart.

source_units.text: And like the bad figs that cannot be eaten because of their badness—thus says the Lord—so I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his nobles, Jerusalem’s remnant left in this land, and those dwelling in Egypt.
source_units.complete_text: And like the bad figs that cannot be eaten because of their badness—thus says the Lord—so I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his nobles, Jerusalem’s remnant left in this land, and those dwelling in Egypt.

source_units.text: And I will give them to scattering into all the earth’s kingdoms, and they will become a reproach, a parable, an object of hatred, and a curse in every place where I drove them out.
source_units.complete_text: And I will give them to scattering into all the earth’s kingdoms, and they will become a reproach, a parable, an object of hatred, and a curse in every place where I drove them out.

source_units.text: And I will send famine, death, and sword against them until they disappear from the land I gave them.
source_units.complete_text: And I will send famine, death, and sword against them until they disappear from the land I gave them.
